Uss Investment Management Ltd Increased Cae Inc (NYSE:CAE) Stake by $36.95 Million
May 10, 2018 - By Richard Conner
Investors sentiment decreased to 1.19 in 2017 Q4. Its down 0.10, from 1.29 in 2017Q3. It worsened, as 10 investors sold CAE shares while 49 reduced holdings. 17 funds opened positions while 53 raised stakes. 128.20 million shares or 3.24% less from 132.48 million shares in 2017Q3 were reported. 15,400 were accumulated by Numeric Invsts Limited Liability. Northern Trust holds 0% or 95,099 shares in its portfolio. Aperio Gru Ltd Liability Com reported 365,630 shares. Wellington Grp Inc Llp invested in 71,660 shares or 0% of the stock. Old Mutual Customised Solutions (Proprietary) holds 0.03% or 13,657 shares in its portfolio. The Connecticut-based Trexquant Limited Partnership has invested 0.03% in CAE Inc. (NYSE:CAE). Wetherby Asset Mgmt invested in 0.04% or 13,989 shares. Guardian Capital Advsr L P reported 9,850 shares stake. Shell Asset Mgmt Comm has invested 0.01% in CAE Inc. (NYSE:CAE). 32,555 are held by Neuberger Berman Group Inc Limited. Us Comml Bank De invested in 12,579 shares or 0% of the stock. 31,388 are held by Dekabank Deutsche Girozentrale. Cibc Markets has 0.09% invested in CAE Inc. (NYSE:CAE) for 1.12M shares. 267,785 were reported by Bank Of Nova Scotia. Winfield Assocs holds 397 shares or 0% of its portfolio.
Uss Investment Management Ltd increased its stake in Cae Inc (NYSE:CAE) by 51.18% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Uss Investment Management Ltd bought 2.05M shares as the company’s stock declined 2.38% with the market. The institutional investor held 6.06 million shares of the industrial machinery and components company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $114.78M, up from 4.01M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Uss Investment Management Ltd who had been investing in Cae Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $5.14B market cap company. The stock increased 1.27% or $0.24 during the last trading session, reaching $19.15. About 50,201 shares traded. CAE Inc. (NYSE:CAE) has risen 20.70% uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.15% the S&P500.
Uss Investment Management Ltd, which manages about $9.01B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 858,523 shares to 1.04M shares, valued at $172.37 million in 2018Q1, according to the filing.
CAE Inc., together with its subsidiaries, designs, makes, and supplies simulation equipment worldwide. The company has market cap of $5.14 billion. It operates in three divisions: Civil Aviation Training Solutions, Defence and Security, and Healthcare. It has a 21.18 P/E ratio. The Civil Aviation Training Solutions segment provides training solutions for flight, cabin, maintenance, and ground personnel in commercial, business, and helicopter aviation; flight simulation training devices; and ab initio pilot training and crew sourcing services.
